title: wholesome russian bananas hash
description: a silky, lazy-sunday russian dish featuring bananas, a diabetic-friendly twist. perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: mash the bananas in a molcajete with a fork until smooth.
heat the infused oil in the molcajete over low heat.
add 1/2 teaspoon of ground black pepper and stir to combine.
add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and stir to combine.
add 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh dill and stir to combine.
cook until the bananas are warm and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
scoop the bananas into a serving dish and garnish with additional fresh dill if desired.
